title: Lijsten van de leveranties, met de namen van de kopers en betaalde prijzen op de verkopingen van de VOC kamer Zeeland, 1725 – 1777
descriptions: To reconstruct the informal networks of the Dutch colonial empire it was necessary to reconstruct the domestic market for colonial goods in the Dutch Republic. This subproject collected data from the VOC auctions in Zeeland to find out who were buying goods from the company.
